method.execution: Source files were fetched from the pinned GitHub commits and reconstructed in an isolated local harness. This is not a clean-clone repository test and therefore does not establish repository-native CI conformance.
method.fixture_basis: kernel-fixtures-v0.1 plus the P0 authority/evidence/continuation fixtures added on control-plane/kernel-contract-v0.1

interpretation.positive_result: The two implementations already share some operational semantics around durable run state, but they do not yet implement the full same semantic contract.
interpretation.negative_result: The current P0 fixtures cannot be passed wholesale by either implementation without inventing semantics that are not present in source.

next_discriminating_actions: Add a repository-native adapter/conformance runner for M0 and UWS rather than a synthetic compatibility layer.
Introduce the smallest Verification record in exactly one execution path and test independent verification.
Introduce UNKNOWN_OUTCOME around a staged external-effect operation and test reconciliation before replay.
Retain authority/evidence provenance as separate semantics; do not infer them from transport metadata.
